instruction: A crisp action photograph with a full, eye-level shot captures an indoor boxing gym with concrete walls and yellow accents. On the left, the man in the orange beanie (R1), wearing a white t-shirt and blue sweatpants, stands holding a black heavy punching bag steady with both hands. On the right, the blonde woman in the purple hoodie (R2), wearing black leggings and brown boxing gloves, stands in a boxing stance and extends her left arm to punch the bag. The man watches the bag intently while the blonde woman focuses on her target. Bright, even indoor lighting illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on the floor.
